craft_notes: Sthāyin: sense-proofs; regress bar. Rows: prove then bar. Read aloud: forge then fence.

lines: In ear, by sound-birth might distinguished — thus;
up to nose, by smell-birth fitness — thus;
no mere element befits — since 'I hear' and the rest runs through,
plain is I-maker-ness; and by engine-ness needs must
touch the maker-part — else, were another engine yoked,
ruin and the rest would fall.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śrotre tu śabdajananasāmarthyaviśiṣṭa iti yāvat ghrāṇe gandhajananayogyatāyukta iti bhautikam api na yuktam ahaṃ śṛṇomi ityādyanugamāc ca sphuṭam āhaṃkārikatvam karaṇatvena ca avaśyaṃ kartraṃśasparśitvam anyathā karaṇāntarayojanāyām anavasthādyāpātāt
